positions.title: Software Consultant/Contractor
positions.description:
College contract job to pay for rent and living costs

Maintain Goodsie.com e-commerce Django platform
Independently review code base for areas of concern and suggest solutions
Write scripts to make day to day tasks easier
Manage and maintain the Celery queue
Be on call 24/7 to fix any issues that arise

positions.title: Backend Director (Volunteer)
positions.description:
Scale backend infrastructure to reflect increase in usage and traffic
Monitor Heroku and server statistics daily for abnormalities
Lead backend team (8 engineers) to build new features and refactor old unscalable code
Roadmap projects that improve the scale and performance of the web servers
Review code other engineers push before merging with master and pushing to Heroku
Provide knowledge of the codebase (65,000 LOC and growing) for other engineers

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer (Volunteer)
positions.description:
Work with a team of other student engineers to add, update, and test new features for the Django app, Berkeleytime.com, that assists thousands of Berkeley students in searching through and querying over 14000 classes

Integrate new Student Information Systems API for course data and update Course modeling to reflect said changes
Assist the Engineering Lead roadmap new features (class scheduler, HTTPS, etc)
Collaborate with the Student Information Systems project to improve their API for Course and Enrollment data
Integrate Sentry for real time crash and exception notification
Implement HTTPS support
Switch caching system from Memcache to Redis

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern: Platform Technology
positions.description:
Improve second level cache performance during rolling updates of application servers by developing and integrating a centralized system that utilizes Redis, Memcached, and Hibernate to coordinate important ORM information between new and old application servers

Install MemSQL on server cluster, load Station data from the Hadoop Distributed File System, and evaluate MemSQL's capabilities

Investigate, debug, and repair remediation server implementation

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Work with Ph.D. student to develop real time web-based API using WebRTC, OpenCV, and Node.js (backend) for the emotion analytics SDK, Affectiva for research and experimental purposes
